Ava (Finance): Heads-up: starting Mon 2026-04-05 were launching a temporary Fast-Track Pilot Procurement path for small R&D/vendor spends. Doc: https://intranet.redwood/finance/fast-track-pilot (summary below). This is to unblock short-term experiments while keeping auditability.

Ava (Finance): Key points: 
• Applies to one-time vendor or purchase requests <= $5,000 USD.
• Single approver allowed (Engineering or Product manager with delegated approval rights).
• Must use the new Fast-Track approval form (link in doc).
• Receipts required within 5 business days; digital-first (scan or photo + OCR tag).
• Policy is a 90-day pilot; compliance and spend will be reviewed weekly.

Tom (Eng): Quick Q — does this cover conference swag for a pilot proof-of-concept?

Ava (Finance): Yes — physical goods and services are fine if one-off and under the $5k cap. For multi-month subscriptions or repeat vendors, use the standard vendor onboarding flow.

Priya (Product): What about SOWs or contractor work? If it's a one-off contractor gig for < $5k, is the same path ok?

Liam (R&D): Also, what counts as a pilot? Small experiment for < 3 months?

Ava (Finance): Answers: contractor work ok if total PAYMENT <= $5k and contractor is not an existing Redwood contractor on an active PO. Pilot = ad-hoc project expected to finish within ~90 days; if you expect extension, switch to standard process early.

procurement-bot: New fast-track form: https://forms.redwood/fast-track-approval — please select the project tag (e.g., r&d-pilot, integrations-test) so we can map to cost centers.

Tom (Eng): Cool. Any change to virtual card usage?

Ava (Finance): Virtual cards still preferred for vendor spend. If you need a one-time vendor card, choose Fast-Track - Virtual Card on the form. Receipt rules still apply.

Priya (Product): If finance approves, who creates the vendor record?

Ava (Finance): For Fast-Track we create a temporary vendor record automatically once the form is approved. That record will be flagged as temporary and will expire after 120 days unless converted via standard onboarding.

Marco (CFO): Appreciated — small add: keep documentation tight. For the pilot we will sample 10% of approvals for compliance review. Exceptions will be escalated.

Liam (R&D): Noted. Any tips for receipts? OCR fail rates killed us last time.

Ava (Finance): Tips: take photos on white background, avoid glare, submit PDF if possible. If OCR fails, add a one-line manual note: what the item was and project tag.

procurement-bot: Reminder: receipts must include date, vendor name, and amount. Missing items will generate an automated reminder to the requester.

Tom (Eng): thanks, will try the form next week. :thumbsup:

Priya (Product): Thanks Ava. Can we get a short pinned checklist in the project channels?

Ava (Finance): Yes — Ill post a 1-slide checklist and the short link to the form in #eng, #product, and #rd by EOD today.

Marco (CFO): Thanks everyone. We'll revisit metrics after two weeks and share a short report with execs.

procurement-bot: Audit log created: https://intranet.redwood/finance/audit/1847654321

Tom (Eng): ack
